items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I will tell Mr. Pedder when I see him.

ctx.x: Yeah. And I was really quite shocked, only for one reason, because I kept reading these glowing reports about how beautiful the band is, and so on. And I

caught the band in Chicago and I -- I shouldn't be shocked, but I -- after reading some of these accolades, I'd like to know why her husband could allow such self-indulgent as 40-minute solos. I can't buy it, plus the fact the writing is all sketchy, it's written for the soloist after he's done, to give him a breath. That's the writing, to me.
